summary: Razorpay payment integration (iteration 3 request) fully tested — backend only. All 11 pytest cases passed against the public URL. Order creation (intro ₹5/credit → 5000 paise for 10 credits; standard ₹15/credit → 15000 paise), tier validation (422), auth (401), verify endpoint (bad signature 400 with no credit, valid HMAC signature credits wallet, replay idempotent), hosted checkout HTML page (contains checkout.razorpay.com script + callback_url, 404 for unknown order), and webhook (bad signature 400, payment.captured credits once, duplicate x-razorpay-event-id deduped) all behave correctly. Real Razorpay test-mode orders were created (order_id prefix 'order_').

minor.issue: rp_client.order.create() is a synchronous blocking call inside an async endpoint (server.py:876) — blocks the event loop during Razorpay API latency. Consider asyncio.to_thread.
Bare 'except Exception' on webhook_events insert (server.py:1013) treats ANY DB error as a duplicate event and silently returns ok=True — transient Mongo failures would drop legitimate events.

action_items: Optional: wrap rp_client.order.create in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the event loop
Optional: narrow webhook dedup exception handling to DuplicateKeyError only
critical_code_review_comments: credit_if_new (server.py:856) uses atomic update_one with credited != True filter — correctly idempotent for both /verify and webhook paths
Webhook signature verified with hmac.compare_digest over raw body before json.loads — correct
India pricing (scan_intro=5, scan_standard=15 INR) seeded to country_pricing on startup and converted to paise correctly
Stripe subscription endpoint remains a stub (503 without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) — as specified in requirements
seed_data_creation: Created fresh test users (rz_*@example.com) via /api/auth/register; each placed real Razorpay test-mode orders. No production/seed data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay flow verified end-to-end in test mode. Valid payment signatures can be computed as hmac.new(RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, (order_id+'|'+payment_id).encode(), sha256).hexdigest(); webhook signatures use RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET over the raw request body with x-razorpay-event-id for dedup. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_5_razorpay.py (run with pytest -n auto).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Razorpay integration is correctly implemented: orders created via real Razorpay test API, amounts derived from seeded India pricing (₹5 intro / ₹15 standard), signature verification via razorpay SDK utility, atomic credit guard prevents double-crediting across /verify, /callback, and /webhook paths.
